xBRIEFInfo.description: Proposed disposable end-to-end Directive capstone scope
xBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup

narratives.Description: Create a deterministic two-hour capstone in a disposable fictional repository. It must prove that a learner can supervise one complete solo Directive-managed change using only written instructions, hints, recovery, and solutions.
narratives.Acceptance: The capstone covers orientation, an approved active scope, story-ready and xBRIEF preflight, test-backed implementation, focused checks, literal acceptance, the aggregate gate, pre-PR self-review, simulated review, and evidence-based closeout. It includes starting-state checks, checkpoints, progressive hints, reset and cleanup, expected evidence, and a complete solution without touching the training or a business repository.
narratives.QualityGate: Run task deft:check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint after the literal acceptance command; do not embed the aggregate gate in plan.acceptance.commands.

items.title: Build the fictional disposable capstone fixture and reset path

narrative.Acceptance: The fixture creates a safe per-run repository, contains no sensitive data or remote destructive action, and can be reset and cleaned up deterministically on every supported operating-system path.

items.title: Author the solo lifecycle capstone, evidence rubric, hints, and solution

narrative.Acceptance: A learner can complete and assess the full lifecycle without undocumented human intervention and can explain why each lifecycle and quality gate exists.

references.title: Capstone: Solo Lifecycle Walkthrough, Rubric, and Solution
